summary: Transforms are a CSS effect, so the HTML is three ordinary cards. Each class name says which transform its card shows.
notes: The h2 in each card names the transform function the CSS applies to it.
Hover any card in the preview: it grows a little, and the tilted card straightens.
A transform changes how an element looks, not what it is. Screen readers read the cards the same way.
pitfall: Using transforms to fix layout problems, like shifting a box until it lines up. The space it takes up does not move, so other elements may overlap it.
